name: blackbox
purpose: Ask your Brainstem what your computer did while you were not looking: what is using the most memory, why it restarted, what is frozen, what the guard did overnight, and let a frozen job carry on or stop it. A recorder that runs beside the Brainstem and one agent file that speaks for it; the kernel is untouched. STAGING: one install, one day of use; it moves down a layer only after real users on more than one install (proven-winner rule).

blackbox_agent.py.purpose: Drop into agents/. Blackbox(ask=biggest|why_restarted|frozen|what_it_did|carry_on|stop, job=<id>) reads a recorder at ~/.blackbox/blackbox.py (or BLACKBOX_PATH). Stop needs one job id and never accepts 'all'.

blackbox.py.purpose: The recorder and guard. Not an agent: run 'python3 blackbox.py install' once per Mac. It keeps itself running beside the Brainstem.

install.notes: First: python3 blackbox.py install (once per Mac; macOS). Then copy blackbox_agent.py into your brainstem's agents/. Ask: 'what happened on my computer overnight?'.

evidence.first_live_loop: 2026-11-27: 4 of 4 /chat turns on a throwaway Brainstem (two small test jobs frozen; one let go, one stopped; nothing left frozen)
